chunks: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa'd Abadi narrated to us from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah al-Barqi from Muhammad b. Salim from Ahmad b. al-Nadr from Amr b. Shimr from Jabir from Abi Ja'far (upon him be peace).
He said: For everything there is a spring, and the spring of the Quran is the month of Ramadan.

key_terms.القرآن: the Quran, the holy scripture of Islam
key_terms.ربيع: spring, season of renewal and growth

ai.seo_question: Why is Ramadan called the spring of the Quran?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir, the fifth Imam, employs the metaphor of spring to describe the relationship between Ramadan and the Quran. Just as spring is the season of renewal and flourishing for nature, Ramadan is the season when the Quran flourishes through increased recitation and reflection. This saying encourages Muslims to devote special attention to the Quran during Ramadan, echoing the Quranic connection between Ramadan and the revelation of the Quran (2:185).
word_analysis: may Allah have mercy on him
